title: Aliens have two sexes and eliminate waste

tellings.quote: >> Um they do have female and male.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US electronic spying agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, told podcast host Jesse Michels what he learned in the early 1990s at a place he calls Base 2. He says the aliens have females and males and that they get rid of bodily waste, much like living creatures here.
